text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I can use magic? I never knew.
That's an
amazing fact.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Don't play dumb! I saw you talking to
that cat! Is
that kitty your familiar?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Cat? You must mean Hattori
Shinobimaru. I had
no idea someone saw
our secret meeting. He's just
my friend,
though.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You can talk to him even though he's
not a
familiar... So you can use magic to
talk with
animals?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've been expanding my circle of friends
recently.
I'm even friends with Yutaro
Akabashira—you
know, that one
old-school mailbox. Heh.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'll have to introduce you sometime.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Inanimate objects too? So you talk to
spirits?!
And you don't even need spells
or wands... Hey,
you really have the
makings of a witch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I, extraordinary Magical Girl Sweepy,
will make
an exception this once and
take you on as my
apprentice!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A magical girl apprentice... Magical
Mascot Machan... Or
Ma-Ma-Machan for
short. That could work.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I have a whole lot to learn, but I'll try
hard,
Master.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, and you know how to show proper
respect! ♪
First things first, show me
where that mailbox
spirit is!
